meta.titleDefault: CK Retro Garage — Connoisseur Car Acquisitions
meta.description: For over 30 years, Cem Köse has sourced, inspected and delivered exceptional cars to discerning owners worldwide. Tell us the car you want.

footer.blurb: A private acquisition house for exceptional automobiles. Every car sourced, inspected and delivered with three decades of expertise.

hero.title: Finding the cars others can't.
hero.subtitle: Three decades of sourcing, inspecting and delivering exceptional automobiles for discerning owners across the world.

founder.title: Every inch inspected. Every car exceptional.
founder.p1: For more than thirty years, Cem Köse has built a reputation on a single principle: never compromise. He personally inspects every aspect of every car — mechanical, cosmetic and historical — before it earns a place in our collection.
founder.p2: It is this obsession with detail, and a proven track record across continents, that lets our clients buy with absolute confidence.
founder.imageAlt: An exceptional car from the CK Retro Garage collection

sourcing.title: We Source
sourcing.body: Whatever car you are looking for — a specific model, a rare specification, an icon you have always wanted — we find it through a global network built over decades.

inspection.title: We Inspect
inspection.body: Cem personally examines every car to the last inch: engine, structure, history and provenance. Nothing is taken on trust; everything is verified.

custody.title: We Safeguard
custody.body: Every car is held in climate-controlled, secure custody with our partners at Collection Suites — protected, maintained and ready.

custody.title: Held in world-class custody at Collection Suites.
custody.body: Our cars are stored, protected and maintained in a climate-controlled, fully secured facility — proof that what we offer is real, cared for, and ready to view.

cta.title: Tell us the car you want.
cta.body: Any make, any era, anywhere in the world. Share your brief and we will begin the search.

sell.title: Have an exceptional car to sell?
sell.body: We place significant automobiles with the right owners — discreetly, and across the world.

collection.title: Cars we have sourced and acquired.
collection.intro: A selection of exceptional automobiles we have found, inspected and placed with the right owners — representative of the standard we hold on every search.
collection.note: Cars shown are examples of past acquisitions. To commission a specific car, start a sourcing request.

car.similarBody: We can source a comparable example to your exact specification.

process.title: How we find, vet and deliver.
process.intro: A rigorous, transparent process refined over thirty years — designed so that you buy with total confidence, no matter where in the world you are.
process.quote: I check every inch of every car I buy. If it is not good enough for my own collection, it is not good enough for my client.

brief.title: The Brief
brief.body: We listen. You tell us exactly what you are looking for — model, specification, condition, budget — and we define the search together.

search.title: The Search
search.body: We draw on a global network built over decades to locate the very best candidates, including cars never publicly advertised.

inspect.title: The Inspection
inspect.body: Cem personally inspects every aspect — engine, structure, electronics, cosmetics — to the last inch. Nothing is assumed.

verify.title: The Verification
verify.body: Provenance, service history, matching numbers and documentation are authenticated before a single recommendation is made.

custody.title: The Custody
custody.body: Your car is secured in climate-controlled storage at Collection Suites, fully protected and maintained until delivery.

deliver.title: The Delivery
deliver.body: We handle logistics, export and import worldwide — delivering your car safely to your door, wherever you are.

about.title: A private acquisition house, trusted worldwide.
about.intro: We are a small, dedicated team built around one man's obsession with exceptional cars — and a global structure to serve clients across the Americas, Europe and Türkiye.
about.founderP1: Cem Köse has spent over thirty years finding the finest quality cars in the world. What began as a passion became an unrivalled expertise in sourcing, inspecting and authenticating exceptional automobiles.
about.founderP2: His method is uncompromising. He inspects every aspect of every car himself, checking every inch — because his name, and his clients' trust, depends on it.
about.founderP3: That standard, and a proven track record across continents, is the foundation on which CK Retro Garage is built.
about.teamIntro: One standard across every market — so that wherever you are, you have someone who speaks your language and knows your region.

bios.founder: Over 30 years finding, inspecting and delivering the best quality cars in the world. He checks every inch of every car personally.
bios.andres: Leads our Latin America division, serving clients across Argentina, Uruguay, Peru, Colombia, Panama, Mexico and Switzerland.
bios.cenk: Leads our division for the USA, Türkiye and the Netherlands.

about.photoNote: Imagery shown represents cars sourced and acquired by the company.

storage.title: Protected, maintained, and ready.
storage.intro: Every car we hold is kept in a climate-controlled, fully secured facility — proof of the quality and care behind everything we do.

climate.title: Climate Controlled
climate.body: Temperature and humidity are precisely managed to preserve paint, leather, rubber and mechanicals in their finest condition.

security.title: Fully Secured
security.body: 24/7 monitored, access-controlled storage ensures every car is protected to the highest standard.

maintenance.title: Actively Maintained
maintenance.body: Cars are exercised and maintained so they remain in perfect running order, ready to view or deliver at any time.

access.title: Private Viewing
access.body: Clients are welcome to inspect their car in person, by appointment, in a discreet and professional setting.

storage.partnerBody: Our cars are held at Collection Suites, a specialist facility for the care and storage of exceptional automobiles.

confidential.title: Discreet & Confidential
confidential.body: Every enquiry is handled with complete discretion. Your details are never shared.

global.title: Sourced Worldwide
global.body: A network built over decades across the Americas, Europe and beyond — including cars never publicly listed.

inspected.title: Personally Inspected
inspected.body: Every car we recommend is inspected to the last inch before it reaches you.

contact.title: Speak with our team.
contact.intro: Wherever you are, you have a dedicated contact who knows your market. Reach out directly, or start a sourcing request.
contact.orSource: Know the car you want? Skip ahead and send us your brief directly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how CK Retro Garage collects and uses your information. Please review it with your legal adviser before launch.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect the details you provide through our forms — such as your name, email, phone number, country and the details of your request — so that we can respond to you.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Your information is used solely to respond to your enquiry, source cars on your behalf, and communicate with you about our services.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We do not sell your data. We share it only within our team and trusted partners as needed to fulfil your request.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: If you are in the EU, Switzerland or another applicable jurisdiction, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any privacy request, contact us at contact@cksretrogarage.com.

privacy.disclaimer: This is placeholder text and not legal advice. Have a qualified lawyer prepare your final privacy policy and cookie notice for GDPR and Swiss compliance.
